description: Mochiichao voice-kit render queue. Single-slot file: pushing a new state triggers the render workflow; git history is the take log. Two shapes: single-line (top-level text+label) or batch (lines[]). One character and one param set per state.

cfg_weight.description: Batch-level CFG weight (0-1). Omit to use the character default from characters.json. Per source-pipe evidence, CFG is effectively never overridden per line.

character.description: Character slot id from characters.json (humans only).

exaggeration.description: Batch-level exaggeration (0-1). Omit to use the character default.

label.description: Single-line shape only. Standard form: <scene>-<line-slug>, e.g. sc01-gate-trampoline.

contour.description: Which of the character's prosody-sheet contours this line uses (wonder, reverence, dead-level, lecturer, baseline, ...).

exaggeration.description: Per-line override - sparingly, register shifts only (a whisper, a manic line reined in).

label.description: Take label, standard form <scene>-<line-slug>. The label is the output filename stem.

prosody_type.description: The story job this line's delivery does (owner prosody directive).

text.description: The line EXACTLY as scripted. Performance is written into the text (caps, ellipses, dashes) - source-pipe practice, kept.

status.description: VOICE-SCRATCH until the owner passes the character's casting; only then may a batch be marked FINAL.

text.description: Single-line shape only - the line to speak.

title: mochiichao-voice-kit render-queue
